description: What kind of Solana account is this address, and should a payment go to it? When to use: Before sending SOL or tokens to an address: to learn whether it is a wallet, a token account (and whose), a mint, a program or another program-owned account. Prefer another tool: To check one transfer end to end with amounts and fees (use `/v1/solana/transfer-readiness`), or to read balances (none are returned). Example: solana_address_kind {"address":"Ffeie177PRngys3SwNH44AYdT9yExm63GAmTXHdmL1k1"}

address.description: Address to classify: Solana wallet address: a base58 string that decodes to exactly 32 bytes

name: solana_address_kind

age_seconds.description: Age of our read at response time

as_of.description: When we read the data from Solana (our read time)

cache.description: Cache state; a composite answer reports the worst state of its reads, miss above stale

commitment.description: Every read is at finalized commitment

slot.description: Lowest context slot of the finalized reads behind the answer; null when none of them carries one, never 0

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

frozen.description: For a token account: true when its state is Frozen, so it refuses transfers; false when Initialized or Uninitialized; null when the token account does not decode, and for every other kind

is_ata.description: For a token account: true when the address is the associated token account of its owner and mint; else null

kind.description: not_found, wallet, nonce, token_account, mint, token_multisig, program, stake, vote or other

mint.description: For a token account: its mint; else null

on_curve.description: For a wallet: false when the address is off the ed25519 curve (a program-derived address); else null

owner_program.description: For other: the program that owns the account; else null

token_owner.description: For a token account: the wallet that owns it; else null

token_program.description: For a token account or mint: the SPL Token or Token-2022 program address; else null

title: Solana address kind
